annotations.title: Validate a business tax ID (any supported country)

description: Validate a business tax or registry ID for any supported country with the deepest check available for it. Norway (organisation number), Finland (Y-tunnus or VAT), France (SIREN, SIRET or VAT), Ireland (CRO company number) and Taiwan (unified business number) are checked live against the official registry: legal name, status (active, dissolved, bankrupt, struck off and others), address, key dates, the source with its licence and the date of the data, verification_level "official_registry" and a pass/review/fail assessment with reasons. Ireland comes from CRO data updated daily, not a live query. Dominican Republic RNC (9 digits) is checked against the DGII RNC register, updated daily (legal and trade name, status, activity, payment regime); an 11-digit cédula of a natural person gets the format check only, without any name. Chile RUT is checked against the SII register of legal entities (updated a few times a year: see source.data_as_of): name, legal form, start date and término de giro (closure = fail). Canada BN (9 digits, or with a program account such as RT0001) is checked against the Corporations Canada register of federal corporations, updated daily (Open Government Licence – Canada): name, status, registered office, dates; it covers federal corporations only, so a BN not found is review, never fail. Argentina CUIT (legal entities, prefixes 30, 33, 34) is checked against the ARCA register of tax conditions: name and registration in Ganancias and IVA (registered, active or exempt, in either = pass; ARCA states no active flag). Paraguay RUC is checked against the DNIT RUC register (monthly): status, plus the name of legal entities only (natural persons: status only). Ecuador RUC (companies and other entities, third digit 6 or 9) is checked against the SRI RUC register (monthly): name, status (ACTIVO = pass, SUSPENDIDO = review, PASIVO = fail), class and dates. Natural persons of Argentina and Ecuador get the format check only (review), without any name. Brazil CNPJ is checked against the Receita Federal CNPJ register (monthly): legal name, legal nature and the head office's situação cadastral (ATIVA = pass, SUSPENSA = review, INAPTA, BAIXADA or NULA = fail); a branch never gets a pass on its own, and individual entrepreneurs (MEI) get their status only. For sole proprietorships (Norway ENK, French entrepreneurs individuels, Finnish sole traders) only the status is returned, without name or address. EU VAT numbers of 24 member states (all but Finland, France and Ireland, which have the registries above) are checked live in VIES, the VAT Information Exchange System of the European Commission: pass = the VAT number is registered for intra-EU transactions today, fail = it is not. VIES is not the trade register, so a valid VAT number does not show that the company is solvent or still registered; the name VIES returns is given only to API-key holders, and Germany and Spain share no name (legal_name null). Czechia (ARES), Latvia (Enterprise Register) and Romania (ANAF) add the legal name and status from the national register, and the company number (id_type "ico") is checked in ARES for Czechia and RPO for Slovakia. Switzerland UID (UID register, live), Israel company number (Companies Register, updated daily) and Singapore UEN (ACRA, updated monthly) are official-registry checks too. United Kingdom company numbers (id_type "crn") are checked live against the Companies House register (name, status, type, incorporation date, registered office; dissolved = fail, liquidation or administration = review); a UK VAT number gets the format check only. If VIES or a register does not answer, the tool returns an error and the call is not billed. Peru, Mexico, Colombia and Costa Rica are answered by the same lookups as their own tools. Every other covered country (including India, and Brazil, Australia, Japan and the United States while their registry switches are off) gets the offline format check with verification_level "format", which never returns pass. Also checked against official data: Australia ABN (Australian Business Register, updated weekly: active or cancelled, entity type, GST; individuals get status only); Japan corporate number (National Tax Agency, updated monthly: name, address, closure); United States EIN as a PARTIAL official source (IRS exempt organizations and SEC filers only; not found = review, never fail). Also checked against official sources: Moldova IDNO (State Register of Legal Units, updated weekly: name, legal form, liquidation; individual enterprises status only); Guernsey Registry number (live: name, type, status); Zambia TPIN (live, Zambia Revenue Authority: status, taxes incl. VAT; individuals status only); Angola NIF (live, AGT: status, in default or not, VAT regime; individuals status only); Mali NIF (live DGI list of ACTIVE taxpayers; not found = review); Seychelles TIN (live, Seychelles Revenue Commission: VAT-registered businesses only; not found = review). When one of these sources is down, the answer is HTTP 503 (not billed).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "NO", "FI", "FR", "IE", "TW", "DO", "CL", "AR", "PY", "EC", "BR", "CA", "DE", "IT", "CH", "SG", "GB", "PE". "EL" is accepted for Greece and "UK" for the United Kingdom.

id.description: The ID as written, with or without the country prefix, spaces, dots or dashes, e.g. "974761076", "1003521-5", "FR90130004955", "98788", "03741302".

id_type.description: Optional ID type when the country has several, e.g. "siren", "siret", "vat", "ytunnus", "cro", "orgnr", "ubn", "rnc", "cedula", "rut", "bn", "ico", "uid", "uen", "crn". Detected from the input when omitted.
